findings.title: Full administrator access: Action:* Resource:*
findings.description: Inline policy EmergencyAccess grants unrestricted access to all AWS services and resources.
findings.recommendation: Scope actions and resources to the minimum required. Replace with service-specific policies.

findings.title: Full administrator access: Action:* Resource:*
findings.description: Managed policy AdministratorAccess grants unrestricted access. Note: this principal also has Deny statements that may restrict effective permissions.
findings.recommendation: Replace AdministratorAccess with scoped policies for the required services.

findings.title: User has never logged in
findings.description: User account was created 9 months ago, no console or API activity recorded.

findings.title: Role has never been assumed
findings.description: Role was created 14 months ago and has never been used.
findings.recommendation: Delete this unused role — it serves no purpose and increases attack surface.

findings.title: Full-service wildcard: s3:*
findings.description: Inline policy S3FullAccess grants all S3 actions on all buckets.
findings.recommendation: Restrict to specific S3 buckets and actions (e.g., s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on the application bucket).

findings.title: Unused IAM service permissions
findings.description: Granted iam:CreateRole, iam:DeleteRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy but none used in 90 days.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused IAM actions: iam:CreateRole, iam:DeleteRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy. Keep: iam:PassRole.

findings.title: Role unused for 245 days
findings.recommendation: Delete this dormant role or investigate if it is still needed.

findings.title: Full-service wildcard: dynamodb:*
findings.description: Managed policy AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess grants all DynamoDB actions.
findings.recommendation: Restrict to specific tables and actions (e.g., dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem).

findings.title: User inactive for 180 days
findings.recommendation: Disable access keys and delete this user if no longer needed.

findings.title: Unused S3 actions detected
findings.description: Granted s3:* but only s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket were used in 90 days.
findings.recommendation: Replace s3:* with specific actions: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket.

findings.title: Role unused for 95 days
findings.description: Last assumed on 2025-12-06. Slightly exceeds the 90-day dormancy threshold.
findings.recommendation: Verify if the staging pipeline is still active; delete if decommissioned.

findings.title: Wildcard resource with specific actions
findings.description: Policy ECSTaskAccess grants 8 EC2 actions on Resource:*.
findings.recommendation: Restrict resource ARNs to the specific VPC, subnets, or instances required.

findings.title: Unused CloudWatch Logs permissions
findings.description: Service logs.amazonaws.com was never accessed in 90 days.
findings.recommendation: Remove CloudWatch Logs access if this Lambda does not write logs through this role.

findings.title: Role has zero attached or inline policies
findings.description: This role has no policies and serves no functional purpose.
findings.recommendation: Review and attach a policy or delete this entity.

findings.title: Unused read-only Redshift access
findings.description: Granted redshift:Describe* but Redshift was never accessed in 90 days.
findings.recommendation: Remove Redshift read access if no longer needed for analytics.
